objects.name: reject_catalog_change()
attributes:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION {{target}}.reject_catalog_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable catalog field' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
